# Reordering supports first, before, and after, and rejects invalid anchors.
exec tuck$exe init
exec tuck$exe add 'Alpha' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Bravo' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Charlie' --state todo
exec tuck$exe add 'Doing anchor' --state doing

exec tuck$exe reorder 003 --first --json
json
stdout '"order": 1'
exec tuck$exe list todo --json
stdout '(?s)"title": "Charlie".*"title": "Alpha".*"title": "Bravo"'

exec tuck$exe reorder 002 --before=003
exec tuck$exe list todo --json
json
stdout '(?s)"title": "Bravo".*"title": "Charlie".*"title": "Alpha"'

exec tuck$exe reorder 001 --after=002 --json
json
exec tuck$exe list todo --json
json
stdout '(?s)"title": "Bravo".*"title": "Alpha".*"title": "Charlie"'

! exec tuck$exe reorder 001
stderr 'choose exactly one of --first, --before, or --after'
! exec tuck$exe reorder 001 --first --after 002
stderr 'choose exactly one of --first, --before, or --after'
! exec tuck$exe reorder 001 --before 001
stderr 'reorder anchor must be a different task in the same state'
! exec tuck$exe reorder 001 --before 004
stderr 'reorder anchor must be a different task in the same state'
! exec tuck$exe reorder 001 --before 999
stderr 'task 999 not found'
! exec tuck$exe reorder --first
stderr 'reorder requires one task number or ID'
